verses.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.sm: IsaraAL elu; ona sosola ai lea o tagata Isaraelu i Juma o Filisitia; ua pauu manunua i latou i le mauga o Kilepoa.

verses.en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul's sons.
verses.sm: Ua tulitatao foi Filisitia ia Saulo ma ona atalii; ona fafasi lea e Filisitia ia Ionatana, ma Apinatapa, ma Makisua, o atalii ia o Saulo.

verses.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
verses.sm: Ua mamafa le taua ia Saulo, ua maua atu o ia e tagata fanafana u, ua manua tele foi o ia i e na fanafana.

verses.en: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Saulo i lona soátau, Ina to ae ia lau pelu, ma tutu'i mai ia te au; ne‘i 00 mai na tagata le peritomeina, ma latou tutu‘i mai, ma faaleaga mai ia te au. A ua le mafai lona soátau, aua ua tele lona fefe; ona tago ai lea o Saulo i le pelu, ma faapaú 1 ona luga.

verses.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.
verses.sm: Ua vaai lona soátau ua oti Saulo, ona faapati foi lea o ia i lana pelu, ua oti foi faatasi ma ja.

verses.en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.
verses.sm: O lea na oti ai Saulo, ma ona atalii e toatolu, ma lona soátau, atoa foi ma ona tagata uma faatasi ma ia i lea aso.

verses.en: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.sm: Ua vaai tagata Isaraelu sa i le tasi itu o le vanu, atoa ma i latou sa i le tasi itu o Ioritana, ua sosola tagata Isaraelu, ma ua oti Saulo ma ona atalii, ona latou lafoai lea o aai, ma sosola i latou; ona o mai lea o Filisitia ua nonofo ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le taeao, ona o atu lea o Filisitia e tatala ofu o e na fasia; Ona latou maua lea o Saulo ma ona ara e toatolu o loo taatitia i le mauga o Kilepoa.

verses.en: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.
verses.sm: Ona latou vavae lea lona ulu, ma tatala ona ofutau, ma ua latou tuu sávali i le nuu o Filisitia, ia faataamilo ona tala‘i i le fale o latou tupua, atoa ma le nuu.

verses.en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuu ona ofutau i le fale o Asaira, a o lona tino ua latou faamauina i le pa o Petesani.

verses.en: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
verses.sm: Ua faalogo e ua nonofo i lapeseKiliata 1 12 mea ua faia e Filisitia 1a Saulo;

verses.en: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o tagata totoa uma, ua savavali atu i latou, ua atoa le po; ua latou ave le tino o Saulo ma tino o ona atalii nai le pa o Petesani, ona o atu lea o i latou i lapese; ona latou susunuina ai lea o i latou.

verses.en: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.sm: A ua ave o latou ivi. ma tanu ai i lalo o le laau tele i lapese, ma latou anapopogi ai i aso e fitu.
